fact: The report says the DPO network forms part of the national data governance effort 'aligned with ... plans to establish a dedicated Data Protection Authority', so the authority is planned and not yet established; no date is given for the statement, so the published date of 2026-03-17 is used.

The Minister of Digital Economy says the DPO network precedes the 'création prochaine' of a national Data Protection Authority, so the authority is not yet created; the published date of 2026-03-16 is used.

On 6 August 2024 the think tank Law & Technologies presented a study saying the Data Protection Authority required by Article 262 of the Digital Code (cited in the article as Loi 20/017) exists on paper but is not yet operational, and called on the government to draft and sign the decree fixing its organisation and functioning.

fact: Article 262 creates an independent administrative Autorité de protection des données with legal personality and administrative and financial autonomy, and says a Prime Minister's decree will fix its organisation and functioning; Articles 267 to 268 set the membership conditions and a four-member bureau; the document does not show it constituted.

The analysis states that Articles 262 to 270 of the Digital Code provide for the Autorité de Protection des Données, to be set up by Prime Ministerial decree, and that a ministerial order of 17 August 2024 (n° CAB/MIN/PT&N/AKIM/KL/KBS/051/2024) provisionally transferred its missions to ARPTIC pending its establishment; the document does not say ARPTIC has acted in that role.

The Digital Code provides in articles 262 to 270 for creating the Autorité de protection des données, which the source says has not yet been set up; the source's date is 2025 and no event date is given.
A ministerial order of 17 August 2024 gave the authority's missions to the ARPTIC, and a Prime Minister's decree is still to fix its organisation and operation.
Beto.cd reports that the Autorité de protection des données is not installed, as the ONIP identification and the census are announced.
DLA Piper says Article 262 of the Digital Code requires a Prime Minister's decree to establish the APD, and that no such decree had been adopted to date; the guide gives only a year, 2024.

Ouragan.cd, AfricaNews and Alternance.cd say article 13 of DRC telecommunications law no. 20/017 of 25 November 2020 assigns the regulator ARPTC the regulation and control of personal data protection; the article does not say the ARPTC does this work.

The ARPTC press release, reported by Numerico.cd, says the new Autorité de Protection des Données (APD) is awaiting operationalisation and the ARPTC remains the body in charge of digital missions meanwhile.

ACTPOL says the DRC's Digital Code (Ordinance-Law No. 23/010 of 13 March 2023) created a Data Protection Authority that has not been set up, and a ministerial order of August 2024 gave its functions to the telecommunications regulator meanwhile.
